title: Finite-Energy Weak Solutions to the Quantum Isothermal Euler System via a Logarithmic Schrödinger Approximation
summary: This paper investigates the collisionless quantum hydrodynamic, or quantum Euler, system in \(\mathbb{T}^3\) with the linear pressure law \(P(ρ)=ρ\). Since this pressure is associated with the logarithmic internal energy \(f(ρ)=ρ\logρ\), the model admits a natural logarithmic Schrödinger approximation. By means of a regularized logarithmic Schrödinger equation, we rigorously construct global weak solutions to the quantum isothermal Euler system.
